notablePrerequisites: There is at least one basic land on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a nontoken Merfolk you control, targeting any basic land.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
When the Merfolk enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping the basic land.
If you controlled the basic land, you may activate it by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
